meta.title: A withdrawn event's status and remark are persisted

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_withdraw_…”, with no attachments.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals withdrawn; Data check: “withdraw details › withdraw remark › remarks” equals QA_Platform_withdraw_{{stamp}}.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals withdrawn; Data check: “withdraw details › withdraw remark › remarks” equals QA_Platform_withdraw_{{stamp}}.
